entities.summary: Domžale Sports Park or Domžale Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium located in Domžale, Slovenia. It is currently used mostly for football matches and is the home ground of NK Radomlje for their matches in the Slovenian First League. It was also the home stadium of NK Domžale until 2026, when the club withdrew from the top division and was dissolved due to financial problems.
